summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its agreement to acquire certain Camden mineral, mining, and infrastructure assets from Covia Solutions LLC for US$3 million. The assets, adjacent to IperionX's Titan Project in Tennessee, include mineral rights, stockpiles, processing equipment, rail spur, approximately 1,400 acres owned and 1,400 acres leased property. The acquisition consolidates the Big Sandy Critical Minerals Province, adding potential heavy rare earth minerals (monazite, xenotime) and pre-processed stockpiles. IperionX plans to advance stockpile surveys, drilling, metallurgical test work, and integration studies. The board has recommended the transaction. No break fee mentioned. Watch for completion of due diligence and regulatory approvals.
